faq.q: How do I install UNO! on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for UNO! and check the developer is Mattel Game Studios HK Limited before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Mattel Game Studios HK Limited and may be altered, so the safest way to play UNO! is the official listing.

faq.q: Is the UNO! app safe for kids?
faq.a: UNO! is rated Everyone. It includes online play with strangers and quick chat, so younger children should play in private rooms with friends and family.

faq.q: Can I play UNO! with friends online?
faq.a: Yes. Create a private room in UNO! and invite friends, or team up in 2v2 mode.
The UNO! app is mainly an online game. Some modes need a connection for matchmaking and events.
